issues: Direct URL /team renders a blank page with no 404 (only the sidebar link works). Consider adding a catch-all NotFound route. Non-blocking for phase-1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1320 lines; consider splitting the inventory importer (COL_SYNS, _detect_header, _slug, _suggest_tag, _parse_sheet, /units/preview, /units/commit) into a units_inventory.py module.

backend/server.py ScheduleRow.due_date is a required str and 'On Offer of Possession' is passed as a magic string by the frontend. Would be cleaner to introduce an optional on_possession: bool field on ScheduleRow and derive display server-side; today the string works but couples FE/BE by convention. Not a phase-1 bug.

Python round() uses banker's rounding — round(111.115,2)==111.11, round(111.125,2)==111.12. Not incorrect but importers using .5-boundary values may see 'off-by-1 paisa' in edge cases; document or switch to Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP if that matters for reporting.

list_units sort by _plot_key falls back to (1,0.0,s) for non-numeric — this places all alpha plots (e.g. TEST_9001) at the end which is fine, but sub-ordering of non-numeric plots is purely lexicographic, which may surprise users on plots like 'A-10' vs 'A-2'.
The Team sidebar link points to /users but the label is 'Team' — consider aliasing /team → /users in the router to avoid the blank page users may hit.
